sources.publisher: Ripple Treasury — First TMS with native digital asset capabilities
claims: Ripple Treasury states it facilitated $13 trillion in payments volume for customers in 2025.

Ripple Treasury announced launch of Digital Account Management and Unified Treasury on April 1, 2026, describing them as its first native digital-asset capabilities embedded directly into a treasury management system.

Digital Account Management enables treasury teams to create and manage a regulated Ripple-native digital asset account within the platform; balances including XRP and RLUSD can appear in the same account structure as cash.
Ripple says customers can view, hold, receive and manage fiat and digital liquidity; multiple customers were in beta before global general availability.
Ripple says the digital-asset framework will soon expand to cross-border/intercompany settlement and 24/7 yield through overnight repo.
limitations: The $13T is 2025 treasury-software payments volume; the digital-asset capabilities were launched in 2026, so the $13T is not evidence of 2025 XRP or RLUSD settlement.
The announcement does not disclose customer XRP balances, actual XRP purchases, on-chain settlement share, XRP-routed payment volume or inventory requirements.
Cross-border/intercompany settlement and overnight repo expansion are described as future capabilities, not verified live production flows.
Product and service availability varies by geography; this is a company statement, not independent customer-level adoption evidence.
